reference_tree_clean_meaning: the reference `lib/` build consumed by the runner is a .gitignore'd build product; the fixed commit's packages/core/session/src was read with git show and was not modified. The local checkout's 70 unrelated modifications were not involved
determinism_check: surface-replacement.json was recorded five times and produced identical bytes
live_verification: TestLiveReferenceSessionSurfaceMatchesRecorded replays the recorded scenarios against the same build and compares them to these files; it is skipped when DSH_PACKAGES or Node is unavailable, and the skip is reported as unverified rather than as a pass

recorded_environment.note: the reference `lib/` existed at the recorded commit and imports without a Cordis host for the surface functions this runner uses

excluded_from_trace: message identifiers: the reference mints them and this project preserves whatever a payload carries, so comparing them would compare a generator rather than a behaviour
wall-clock time: only the recorded `time` field in the scenario is observable, never the current clock
reuse: these traces are the reference side of the session surface parity scenarios; regenerating them requires re-reviewing testdata/parity/session/DIVERGENCES.md
